props.title:
Indian Auto Stocks
The Vehicle Makers
props.sub: 18 companies · what they do · latest quarter · P/E · their moat

props.title: The Four-Wheelers
props.sub: Cars, SUVs, vans — and the electric shift

props.name: Maruti Suzuki
biz: India's number-one carmaker — Suzuki small cars to SUVs like Swift, Brezza and Grand Vitara
The widest sales and service network in the country
A leading exporter of cars made in India

fin.note: Volumes up ~29%, but margins squeezed by raw-material costs and model mix.

props.moat: Unmatched distribution — around 4,000 outlets, scale-driven low costs and resale value nobody can match.

props.name: Hyundai Motor India
biz: India's number-two carmaker — SUV-led, with Creta, Venue, i20 and Verna
Builds locally and exports across dozens of markets
The India arm of Korea's Hyundai Motor

fin.note: Hit by a plant fire and West-Asia export disruption; rural mix at an all-time high.

props.moat: Brand pull and SUV-design leadership, plus a large export base that softens India's ups and downs.

props.name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles
biz: Tata's demerged passenger-vehicle and EV business
Home to Nexon, Punch and Harrier — and India's best-selling electric cars
Also owns Jaguar Land Rover, the global luxury brands

fin.note: Q1 India PV sales up 46%, EV volumes up 112%. Earnings swing with Jaguar Land Rover.

props.moat: India's EV-car first-mover with a charging ecosystem, plus JLR's global brands — offset by JLR's cyclicality.

props.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
biz: India's SUV powerhouse — Thar, Scorpio, XUV and BE electric SUVs
The country's number-one tractor maker, by a wide margin
Plus finance, IT and mobility arms

fin.note: Broad-based: autos, farm equipment and services all grew.

props.moat: Tractor-market leadership plus a red-hot SUV franchise — deep rural distribution few rivals can match.

props.name: Force Motors
biz: Makes the Traveller vans, plus Urbania and Gurkha utility vehicles
Assembles engines and axles for BMW and Mercedes-Benz in India
Also builds tractors and small commercial vehicles

fin.note: Profit grew strongly on a modest revenue rise.

props.moat: Near-monopoly in shared-mobility vans, plus sticky, high-trust engine-assembly contracts with BMW and Mercedes.

props.name: Hero MotoCorp
biz: The world's largest two-wheeler maker by volume
Commuter king — Splendor and HF Deluxe dominate the mass market
Now pushing scooters, premium bikes and Vida electric

fin.note: Profit dip is a high base — last year had a one-off gain.

props.moat: Unrivalled scale and the deepest rural dealer network — the lowest cost per bike. Watch the EV transition.

props.name: Bajaj Auto
biz: Pulsar and Dominar bikes, plus Chetak electric scooters
Dominates three-wheelers and exports heavily
Owns stakes in KTM and Husqvarna

fin.note: Consolidated numbers jump further after folding in its KTM holding.

props.moat: A world-class export franchise, near-duopoly in three-wheelers, and premium bikes powered by KTM tech.

props.name: TVS Motor
biz: Apache bikes, Jupiter scooters and the iQube electric
Strong exports, and owns the Norton brand
A relentless premiumisation push
props.moat: Design and premiumisation, plus fast-growing iQube EV leadership — a rich P/E prices this optimism in.

props.name: Eicher Motors
biz: Owns Royal Enfield — India's iconic mid-size motorcycle brand
A near-monopoly from 250 to 750cc
Half-owns the VECV truck and bus joint venture with Volvo

fin.note: Royal Enfield sold a record 332,940 motorcycles.

props.moat: One of Indian autos' strongest brand moats — cult loyalty and pricing power around Royal Enfield.

props.name: Atul Auto
biz: Gujarat maker of Atul Gem and Shakti three-wheelers
Diesel, CNG, petrol and electric last-mile autos
A small player trying to turn the corner

fin.note: Fast growth — but off a small base; profit is only about ₹8 crore.

props.moat: Modest — a regional three-wheeler brand chasing an EV turnaround, not a structural edge.

props.name: Ather Energy
biz: Premium 450-series electric scooters
In-house Atherstack software and the Ather Grid charging network
Designs its own vehicles and batteries

fin.note: Loss narrowed sharply and — importantly — EBITDA turned positive.

props.moat: An emerging tech moat — its own software and fast-charging network — but it's still loss-making.

props.name: Ola Electric
biz: S1-series electric scooters — once the clear market leader
Vertically integrated, with its own battery-cell gigafactory plan
Now entering electric motorcycles

fin.note: Revenue slid and share slipped; it raised ₹780 crore to keep funding operations.

props.moat: Contested and weak — scale on paper, but falling share, heavy cash burn and trust issues.

props.name: Olectra Greentech
biz: India's largest electric-bus maker
Built on a BYD technology tie-up
Also makes composite insulators for the power grid

fin.note: Fresh Q1 FY27 results land 13-Aug; figures shown are the prior June quarter.

props.moat: First-mover leadership in e-buses, with BYD tech and its MEIL parent's order access — but working-capital heavy.

props.name: Mercury EV-Tech
biz: A micro-cap in electric two- and three-wheelers
Makes e-rickshaws, EV parts and battery tech
Very small scale and weak returns

fin.note: Q1 FY27 due 13-Aug; sales are trending down toward ₹20 crore. Return on equity ~1.5%.

props.moat: Effectively none — sub-scale, low returns, and earnings that lean on other income. Speculative.

props.title: Tractors & Legacy
props.sub: Farm power, engines and old names

props.name: Swaraj Engines
biz: Makes diesel engines for Swaraj-brand tractors
The sole engine supplier to Mahindra's Swaraj line
Just crossed 2 million engines made

fin.note: Record engine volumes; the business is cash-rich and high-return.

props.moat: A deep captive moat — the sole, sticky engine supplier to Mahindra's Swaraj tractors. That's also its dependency.

props.name: VST Tillers Tractors
biz: India's leading power-tiller maker
Also small tractors, weeders and farm machinery
Serves small-farm mechanisation

fin.note: Q1 volumes rose about 22%. Full results and the earnings call are on 13-Aug.

props.moat: Category leadership in power tillers — dominant share and dealer reach across the small-farm belt.

props.name: Tube Investments
biz: Murugappa-group engineering — precision steel tubes and chains
Bicycles — Hercules and BSA
Building an EV arm: TI Clean Mobility, with e-3Ws, tractors and trucks

fin.note: Diversified: tubes, chains, cycles — plus a fast-scaling clean-mobility EV business.

props.moat: Murugappa's disciplined capital allocation and a diversified engineering platform, with real EV optionality.

props.name: Atlas Cycles (Haryana)
biz: Once India's largest bicycle brand
Cycle operations are now largely dormant
The story today is legacy real-estate assets

fin.note: Sales collapsed to about ₹7 crore; the stock trades well below its book value.

props.moat: None operationally — the value case is legacy land, not the business.

props.title: Vehicle Makers — in one breath
items: Maruti & Hyundai: scale, service and SUVs rule the car market
M&M: SUV heat plus India's tractor throne — a wide moat
Hero, Bajaj, TVS: two-wheeler giants, each with its own edge
Eicher: Royal Enfield — the strongest brand moat here
Ather, Ola, Olectra: the electric bet — still mostly loss-making
Swaraj & VST: quiet, cash-rich farm-power niches
Valuations range wildly — from ~20× to over 80× earnings
props.closer: Moats last longer than momentum — and the price you pay still matters.
